endangerment.comment: Wagdi (wbr-wbr) = 3 (Wider communication). Became widespread in the 19th century, mainly concentrated in Madhya Pradesh, Rajasthan, Gujarat, and Maharashtra. Promoted by the government of Rajasthan for educational purposes. Used in trade, at home (among older people), in education, mass media, short stories, literature, farming, and hunting.
